name: Riccarton Newcomer Rumble 2026
information:
# Registration Is Free For All Newcomers

If this is your first WCA competition, please do not pay the registration fee and  your events. We will manually approve your registration.

Riccarton Newcomer Rumble is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition.

This competition is open to all competitors regardless of age, experience, or skill. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary.

Please make sure to read all the information in the FAQ and other tabs before registering. All competitors should be familiar with the information in these tabs.
